channel.title: Winter Candle Decor
channel.description: Winter Candle Decor — printables and SVG designs

item.title: 20 Winter Candle Decor Ideas
item.description: Nothing softens a winter evening like candlelight — these 20 winter candle decor ideas bring that glow indoors. Printable candle labels, lantern signs and warm SVG accents make every corner feel calm and bright. Pick a design, print it, and let the light do the rest.

item.title: Cozy Winter Candle Pinecone Decor Graphics
item.description: Woodland pinecone and candle graphics in warm amber and forest tones. Perfect for winter paper crafts, tags, and cozy seasonal wall art.

item.title: Glowing Candle In Snow Cutting Board Graphics
item.description: A glowing candle in a snowy scene for cutting board engraving. Warm contrast and farmhouse charm for functional winter decor.

item.title: Mason Jar Candle Svg Winter Home Decor Graphics
item.description: Winter-themed mason jar candle SVGs in soft rose, sage, and oat tones. Ideal for vinyl decals, gift jars, and cozy handmade decor.

item.title: Christmas Candle Decor Laser Cut Svg Laser Cutting
item.description: Intricate laser-cut Christmas candle decor with delicate scrollwork. Perfect for wood ornaments, table accents, and artisanal holiday styling.

item.title: Cozy Winter Png Winter Vibe Png Design Graphics
item.description: Soft winter PNG elements with candle glows and knit textures. Perfect for layering in digital planners, journals, and cozy seasonal designs.

item.title: Holly And Berries Candle Digital Paper Graphics
item.description: Painterly holly and berry digital papers with candlelit tones. Rich, layered textures for scrapbooking, gift wrap, and vintage-style crafts.

item.title: Holly And Berries Candle Digital Paper Graphics
item.description: Painterly holly and berry digital papers with candlelit tones. Rich, layered textures for scrapbooking, gift wrap, and vintage-style crafts.

item.title: Winter Village Candle Holder Svg Laser Cutting
item.description: Laser-cut winter village candle holder with glowing window details. A charming lantern-style piece for tealights and cozy holiday tabletops.

item.title: Snowflake Tealight Holder Svg Bundle Laser Cutting
item.description: A snowflake tealight holder SVG bundle for laser cutting. Multiple delicate designs that cast patterned light across winter tablescapes.

item.title: Christmas Boho Watercolour Clipart Graphics
item.description: Boho watercolour Christmas clipart in earthy terracotta, sage, and blush tones. Modern, sun-warmed holiday elements for crafts and digital designs.

item.title: Laser Cut Candle Holder Christmas Svg Graphics
item.description: Laser-cut candle holder with snowflake and botanical fretwork that casts dancing shadows. Cut in 3mm plywood, pair with a battery tealight.

item.title: Cozy Candle Sticker Holiday Decor Graphics
item.description: Cozy candle stickers with knit textures and steaming mugs in oat, clay, and charcoal. Perfect for personalizing jars and handmade holiday gifts.

item.title: Watercolor Rustic Lantern Clipart Graphics
item.description: Watercolor rustic lantern clipart with soft washes, weathered metal, and pine sprigs. Layer over wood textures for farmhouse-style cards and tags.

item.title: Christmas Gift Boxes Set Of 3 Laser Cutting
item.description: Set of three laser-cut gift boxes with filigree snowflake lids and warm wood tones. Reusable as tealight or keepsake holders after the gift is opened.

item.title: Hand Drawn Christmas Icons Graphics
item.description: Hand-drawn Christmas icons with wobbly, sketchbook-style charm. Ideal for candle labels, gift tags, and journal spreads that feel personal and handmade.

item.title: Skunk Candle Cave Cozy Winter Joy Png Graphics
item.description: Adorable skunk curled by a candle in a cozy winter cave, rendered in soft amber and taupe. A whimsical transparent PNG for stickers and gift projects.

item.title: Navy Blue Winter Watercolor Clipart Graphics
item.description: Navy blue winter watercolor set with frosted branches and snowflakes. Wrap printed vellum around candle holders for a serene, glowing lantern effect.

item.title: Hygge Logo Vector Graphics
item.description: Minimal hygge logo vector with rounded lettering and a subtle flame motif. A warm, scalable mark for candle labels, wax seals, and websites.

item.title: Hygge Logo Vector Graphics
item.description: Hygge vector logo with soft curves and a gentle flame in cream and honey tones. Legible at any size, ideal for candle branding and packaging.

item.title: Merry Christmas Seamless Pattern Graphics
item.description: Seamless Merry Christmas pattern with candy canes, ornaments, and greenery in red, green, and gold. Scale it for labels, tags, or gift wrap.
